summary: Registration form — delete registration record with confirmation dialog
description: Users with admin role can permanently delete an aircraft registration record. A confirmation dialog must be presented before the deletion is executed.

acs.text: Delete button is visible only to users with admin role; non-admin users do not see the button
Clicking Delete opens a modal dialog with the text: 'Are you sure? This action cannot be undone.' and Confirm / Cancel buttons
Clicking Confirm in the dialog triggers a DELETE request to /api/registrations/{id}
On a 200 response, the record is removed from the list view and a banner displays 'Registration deleted'
